newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes up 0.65 at 1,073.45.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes up 0.65 at 1,073.45.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed up 0.65 against the dollar at 1,073.45 in active trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

They said solid demand for dollars early in the trading session, partly fueled by Monday's U.S. holiday, pushed the peso to an intraday low of 1,076.80. But subsequent dollar-selling by Colombia's Treasury, at 1,076.00, drove the peso back up to a session high of 1,072.00.
Dealers reported an above-average 375 trades for a total of $167 million.
